verdict.rationale: The API changelog's `legal_entity_id` filter on List users shows Brex models multiple legal entities within one account. Bill pay mentions paying "in more currencies" and the spend product mentions managing "global spend," which hints at multi-currency support. Nothing in the pack documents consolidated cross-entity reporting or separate per-entity books. Missing for 10: consolidated reporting across entities, per-entity ledgers/books, explicit multi-currency account and reporting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
